verdict.rationale: Porkbun's docs describe several building blocks for unattended background automation — auto-renewal across a portfolio, signed real-time webhooks in place of polling, dynamic DNS caller-IP detection, and idempotent API calls — plus an MCP server that lets an agent act on commands. These support autonomous, no-polling operation but are all first-party doc claims with no independent/hands-on confirmation that a background automation (e.g., a cron job or webhook-triggered pipeline) actually runs unattended end-to-end. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of an autonomous background workflow, and a dedicated 'automation/workflow' orchestration layer beyond webhooks+auto-renew+API primitives.
